name: ProjectMemo
typeZh: 中国高校计算机大赛—人工智能创意赛 · Agent 创新方向
description: A proactive project-memory agent for project-based learning: it distills scattered fragments — paper notes, bugs, meeting conclusions, experiment logs — into linked, traceable long-term memory, then pushes evidence-backed, confirmation-gated actions through to deliverables.
descriptionZh: 面向大学生项目制学习的主动推进 Agent：将论文笔记、代码报错、会议结论、实验记录等碎片沉淀为可关联、可追溯的长期项目记忆，主动发现截止日期与风险缺口，推动证据支撑、需用户确认的行动闭环，直至自动生成周报、答辩大纲等交付成果。
details: Designed the core loop of capture → knowledge cards → proactive intervention → action loop → reflection, with five rule-based triggers covering deadlines, risks, stagnation, experiment gaps, and material gaps.
Shipped a Next.js/Prisma backend shared by a web client and a native HarmonyOS (ArkTS) app, with hybrid keyword + embedding memory retrieval.

Mock-first LLM pipeline (OpenAI-compatible with deterministic offline fallback) so every demo runs without network or keys; the agent proposes, the user confirms, and every reminder cites its evidence cards.
detailsZh: 设计「碎片捕获 → 知识卡片 → 主动介入 → 行动闭环 → 复盘沉淀」核心链路，内置截止日期、风险、停滞、实验缺口、材料缺口五类规则触发器。
以 Next.js/Prisma 后端同时支撑 Web 端与鸿蒙 ArkTS 原生客户端，记忆检索采用关键词 + 向量混合召回。
LLM 管线离线可演示（OpenAI 兼容 + 确定性降级）；智能体只建议、用户确认，每条提醒均可溯源到证据卡片。

name: Math Modeling Evidence Harness
description: An evidence, verification, and competition-compliance harness for math-modeling contests: it turns a competition project into a manifest-driven pipeline with artifact DAGs, verification gates, and auditable AI-usage disclosure.
descriptionZh: 面向数学建模竞赛的证据、验证与合规 Harness：把比赛项目变成由清单驱动的流水线——工件 DAG、验证门禁与可审计的 AI 使用披露。
details: CLI core (harness.py): init/status/prepare/check drive a project through staged milestones with competition profiles (CUMCM etc.) and presets.
AI-usage ledger with human-verified gates — every external AI interaction is recorded, reviewed, and synced to AI_USAGE_LEDGER.md before formal gates can pass.
Deterministic projections (artifact DAG, run manifest, run index) keep results and papers reproducible and audit-ready.
detailsZh: CLI 核心（harness.py）：init/status/prepare/check 驱动项目按里程碑推进，内置比赛画像（CUMCM 等）与预设。
AI 使用台账与人工核验门禁——每次外部 AI 使用都需登记、人审并同步到 AI_USAGE_LEDGER.md，未核验会阻断正式 Gate。
确定性投影（工件 DAG、运行清单、运行索引）让结果与论文可复现、可审计。

name: Luojia Digital Math Assistant
typeZh: 武汉大学首届「火山杯」智能体创新大赛
description: A multimodal math reasoning agent based on RAG and Tool-Calling for Higher Mathematics and Linear Algebra.
descriptionZh: 基于 RAG 与工具调用的多模态数学推理智能体，支持高等数学与线性代数的教学与解题。
details: Built a low-code teaching agent supporting text and image input, integrating OCR, knowledge base retrieval (RAG), and Python tool calling.
Designed an 'Intent Recognition - Tool Call - Result Verification' workflow using SymPy/NumPy for calculation validation and visualization.
Collaborated on building a specialized math knowledge base and evaluation dataset from textbooks and open-source data.
detailsZh: 基于低代码平台搭建面向高等数学/线性代数的教学智能体，支持文本与图片输入，集成 OCR、知识库检索 (RAG) 与 Python 工具调用。
设计 “意图识别—工具调用—结果验证” 的智能体工作流，结合 SymPy/NumPy 完成计算验证与可视化，提升复杂数学问题求解的可靠性。
参与构建数学领域知识库与评测数据集（教材+开源数据），完成数据清洗、结构化处理与检索优化。

name: Multimodal Document Understanding & Structural Parsing
nameZh: 多模态文档理解与结构化解析
description: Designed and implemented an end-to-end document parsing system with batch processing, checkpointing, and exception retry, improving stability and reproducibility.
descriptionZh: 设计并实现文档解析端到端系统，支持批量处理、断点续跑及异常重试，提升任务执行稳定性与可复现性。
details: Optimized GPU inference environments (CUDA/dependency conflict resolution), significantly increasing parsing efficiency.
Built data cleaning and synthetic enhancement pipelines for improved model robustness in complex layouts.
Implemented a complete evaluation loop with metrics monitoring (mAP/F1/BLEU/TEDS) for continuous optimization.
detailsZh: 优化 GPU 推理环境（CUDA/依赖冲突排查），显著提升解析效率并降低运行失败率。
构建数据清洗与合成增强管道，提升模型在复杂版式与噪声文档场景下的鲁棒性。
实现评测闭环与指标监控，支持多指标（mAP/F1/BLEU/TEDS）自动化评估与持续优化。
